lines: Wait... something's wrong with its signal!
It's changing on its own! The enemy is using signal modulation to evade our jamming!
Look at the oscilloscope! Its amplitude is constantly shifting!
Keep adjusting the AMPLITUDE knob to stay matched. Don't take your eyes off those waves!
It's directly over us, we are doomed...
Strike aircraft are fast, and their constantly shifting signals make them especially dangerous.
Stay alert. Not every target will make matching its signal this easy.
